blocks.text: URDANETA CITY—Barangay Catablan residents in Urdaneta City are mourning Capt. Raymart Cabangcala, their village’s first Philippine Military Academy graduate. Cabangcala was among four Philippine Air Force (PAF) pilots killed in a midair collision in Batangas on Oct. 23. Myrna, 66, Cabangcala’s mother, told the Inquirer that her son had big dreams for his family and community. READ: Widow, schoolmates mourn PAF pilot killed in training flight Catablan village chief Ismael Zabala said the village was preparing a necrological service for when Cabangcala’s remains arrive at the family home on Friday, Oct. 30.
